title: Only the AuthorizationPermissionMismatch 403 may trigger the proxied-upload fallback
answers: Azure upload silently falls back to proxy when authentication fails
Azure 403 error hidden during artifact upload
why does MLflow Azure upload retry through the server on auth errors
body:
Symptom: Azure artifact uploads quietly go through the MLflow server proxy instead of failing when the real problem is authentication, account or network-policy denial, throttling, or a transient error.
Root cause: Converting every HttpResponseError with status 403 into _UnsupportedMultipartUploadException makes the HTTP artifact client treat it as "multipart unsupported" and retry the whole file through the proxy.
Fix pattern: In create_multipart_upload, catch HttpResponseError around get_user_delegation_key and convert only when e.status_code == 403 and e.error_code == "AuthorizationPermissionMismatch" (RBAC missing for delegation key). Re-raise everything else unchanged, preserving the original exception object.
Constraints: Authentication (e.g. AuthenticationFailed), AuthorizationFailure, non-403 statuses and generic Azure failures must propagate. Tests assert the original error object is re-raised for AuthorizationFailure and for a 500.
applies: Applies to any new error handling around Azure SAS or delegation-key calls in the artifact repository.
says: Azure artifact uploads are unexpectedly routing through the server instead of failing on authentication.
Artifact uploads to cloud storage silently slow down when credentials are misconfigured.
Display the actual Azure permission error instead of quietly proxying the file upload.
Why is the system rerouting failed cloud storage uploads through the backend server?
Network policy denials during artifact upload should fail immediately without retrying through the proxy.
search: In Azure blob artifact repository multipart uploads, only an HttpResponseError with status 403 and error code AuthorizationPermissionMismatch may trigger the proxied-upload fallback. In create_multipart_upload in mlflow/store/artifact/azure_blob_artifact_repo.py, get_user_delegation_key converts that specific error into _UnsupportedMultipartUploadException. All other exceptions, including AuthenticationFailed, AuthorizationFailure, non-403 status codes, and 500 server errors, must be re-raised preserving the original exception object.
